source: homedepot.com product page read in the owner's Chrome (free): window.__APOLLO_STATE__['base-catalog-316627328'].identifiers, values of the identity fields only
what: Home Depot's product page state carries the product's barcode. The app's Chrome readers do not keep it: on Nov 25 the owner's catalog (50 entries) and part prices (200) held no barcode at all.
